en.bdb: Successful transaction they do in the holy congregation ,  -

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaar padhaarath hath joR hukamee ba(n)dhe rahan khaRote|

en.bdb: The four ideals (dharma, arth, ktim, moks) stand w'th folded hands around the obedient servant (of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਚਕ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਇਕ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaare chak nivaiaa pairee pai ik soot parote|

en.bdb: This servant has made the four directions bow to him by bowing to One who has strung one and all into one thread.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: vedh na pain bhedh kih paR paR pa(n)ddit sun sun srote|

en.bdb: The Vedas, the reciter pandits of the Vedas and their audience cannot understand His mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਦਰ ਜਾਗਦੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: chahu jug a(n)dhar jaagadhee ot pot mil jagamag jote|

en.bdb: His ever radiant flame glows in all the four yugso ages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਵੜੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ik varan hoi gursikh vaReean gurmukh gote|

en.bdb: The Sikhs of all the four vamas became one varna and they have entered the (larger) clan of Gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੀਜਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਸੁ ਵਣਜ ਸਓਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: dharamasaal vich beejadhe kar gurapurab su vanaj sote|

en.bdb: They at the abodes of dharma (Gurdvaras) celebrate anniversaries of the Gurus and thus sow the seeds of virtuous actions.
In the holy congregation the grandson and the grandfather (i.e. young and old) are equal to each other.
